highlights: Landscaped gardens with bothy / home office and additional banked barn with development potential
summary: Situated in a quiet hamlet, in the upper Eden Valley, with direct access to the Pennines & easy access to Brampton, Kirkoswald & Lazonby, a well presented, detached, spacious and flexible 3 bedroom barn conversion, sat in landscaped gardens with bothy & additional barn with development potential.
description:
Found in well maintained and presented order throughout, with an most interesting configuration having accommodation over three floors, The Granary is a generously proportioned, traditional barn, built in local red sandstone, and carefully and thoughtfully converted into a charming and appealing family home.

Sat in a sheltered valley, with easy access to the close by North Pennines Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty, the property sits in landscaped gardens, and benefits from having a detached bothy, with power, light and a wood burning stove making ideal for use as a hobby room or home office, and also an additional banked barn, which has excellent potential, subject to the necessary permissions for further development.

Accommodation wise, the property comprises to the lower floor an oak framed reception sitting room, which has a triple aspect and is open to the kitchen.

From the kitchen stairs lead up to the main hallway, which has wood burning stove, arched doorway to the garden and gives access to the main bedrooms. Stairs lead from here to the galleried lounge above, a further bedroom and the family bathroom.

A wonderful opportunity for a peaceful rural home, viewing is highly recommended to appreciate.

Directions From Penrith head towards Lazonby & then pass through Kirkoswald, turning right at the top of the hill. Follow the signs to reach Renwick and head straight though to reach the right turning for Scalehouse after approximately 1 mile. Head up the hill and foolow the road to reach the property which is on the left hand side.
